title: Implement: `total_tax`
body: Spec: Total sales tax for an order.

title: Refactor: `tax_breakdown`
body: Use `collections.defaultdict` to simplify the accumulation. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `money`
body: Add an optional keyword `cents: bool = False`; when True the value is an integer number of cents (e.g. 1999 -> 19.99). Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Performance: `total_tax`
body: Look up each category's rate once instead of once per line. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Implement: `line_tax`
body: Spec: Sales tax owed for one line item in a region.

title: Feature: `tax_breakdown`
body: Add `include_zero: bool = False`; when True, every category of the region appears (0.00 if absent). Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `money_sum`
body: Implement the per-value conversion and the final quantize inline in `money_sum` so it no longer calls `money()`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `line_subtotal`
body: Compute and round the subtotal inline so `line_subtotal` no longer calls `money()`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Implement: `tax_breakdown`
body: Spec: Sales tax per tax category for an order.

title: Feature: `line_subtotal`
body: Add an optional `quantity: int | None = None` that overrides `item.quantity` when given. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Implement: `money_sum`
body: Spec: Sum money values into a cent-rounded Decimal.

title: Performance: `line_net`
body: Avoid computing the subtotal twice. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `make_line_item`
body: Restructure the validation into a clear sequence of guard clauses with descriptive error messages. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `tax_breakdown`
body: Compute each line's tax inline instead of calling `line_tax`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `total_tax`
body: Sum the line taxes without calling `money_sum`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Implement: `line_net`
body: Spec: Line amount after the line's discount.

title: Implement: `make_line_item`
body: Spec: Construct a validated LineItem from raw inputs.

title: Feature: `tax_rate`
body: Make region lookup case-insensitive (`'us-ca'` should work). Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `line_discount`
body: Express the percentage as a fraction (`pct / 100`) once and make the computation easier to read. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Implement: `line_discount`
body: Spec: Discount amount for one line item.
